scripts.text:
Wait a minute!
-You need to have an-
-^4d4dff'Eden Group Mark'^000000-
-to receive these missions.-
scripts.translation:
等一下！
-您需要持有-
-^4d4dff'樂園團徽章'^000000-
-才能領取這些任務。-

scripts.text: Just walk away.
scripts.translation: 直接離開

scripts.text: ^0000FFEden Group^000000 missions?
How can I be a member of the ^0000FFEden Group^000000?
scripts.translation: 如何成為^0000FF樂園團^000000的成員？

scripts.text:
::The Eden Group Missions
::are basically missions
::requested by
::people from all around the kingdom.
::We just categorize them.
scripts.translation:
::樂園團的任務
::基本上是王國各地人們
::提出的委託。
::我們只是負責分類。

scripts.text:
::In the Eden Group,
::we sorted out the missions
::according to the level of difficulty.
::According to this level,
::you can find
::missions that
::suit you.
scripts.translation:
::樂園團會按照任務難度
::對委託進行分類。
::您可以根據等級，
::尋找適合自己的任務。

scripts.text:
::When you are done,
::you can come back
::to the mission board.
scripts.translation:
::完成後，
::您可以回到
::任務板。

scripts.text:
::Then you will be
::rewarded!!
::Simple, isn't it!!
::No commission required!!
scripts.translation:
::然後您將獲得
::獎勵！！
::很簡單，不是嗎！！
::無需手續費！！

scripts.text:
::You can become a member
::of the Eden Group
::to ^0000FFLaime Evenor^000000,
::who is waiting on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
::向在一樓等候的
::^0000FF萊梅·艾文諾^000000申請
::加入樂園團。

scripts.text:
::If you become a member,
::you will get an
::"^006400Eden Group Mark^000000".
::Then you will be able
::to see the mission board.
scripts.translation:
::成為成員後，
::您會獲得
::“^006400樂園團徽章^000000”，
::之後就能檢視任務板了。

scripts.text: You must be within level 91-99 to accept these missions.
scripts.translation: 您的等級必須在91-99級之間才能接受這些任務。

^8B4513Turtle Island^000000.
Which monster will you hunt or have you finished hunting?
scripts.translation:

要狩獵哪種魔物？還是已經完成狩獵了？

scripts.text: ^0000FFSolider^000000
^0000FFFreezer^000000
^0000FFHeater^000000

[91-99 Mission Board]
There is a monster that only can be found on ^8B4513Turtle Island^000000.
scripts.translation:
[91～99級任務板]
只有在^8B4513海龜島^000000才能找到這種魔物。

scripts.text:
[91-99 Mission Board]
Hunt 30 Solider monsters there and post your success on this board.
scripts.translation:
[91～99級任務板]
在那裡狩獵30只士兵，並在此任務板登記完成情況。

scripts.text: I'll hunt them.
scripts.translation: 我會去狩獵的

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[91-99 Mission Board]
You need to wait 3 hours before you can take this mission again.
scripts.translation:
[91-99級任務板]
您需要等待3小時才能再次接受此任務。

scripts.text:
[91-99 Mission Board]
Have you finished hunting all 30 Solider yet?
scripts.translation:
[91～99級任務板]
您已經狩獵完30只士兵了嗎？

scripts.text:
[91-99 Mission Board]
You have completed the hunting.
Please accept this reward as a compensation.
scripts.translation:
[91-99級任務板]
您已完成狩獵。
請領取這份獎勵作為補償。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[91～99級任務板]
